Yes. The agent already has an OpenRouter backend. To try the provided Qwen Flash model, configure:

```env
LLM_BACKEND=openrouter
LLM_MODEL=qwen/qwen3.8-flash
LLM_PROVIDER=alibaba
OPENROUTER_API_KEY=your-key
```

OpenRouter links that model to the [Qwen3.8 Flash Next weights](https://openrouter.ai/qwen/qwen3.8-flash). Its [current endpoint listing](https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models/qwen/qwen3.8-flash/endpoints) shows Alibaba, so the repo’s default `fireworks` provider pin must be changed for this model.

This is **unlikely to be faster by itself**: OpenRouter currently routes it to Alibaba, while [Fireworks lists Flash Next as on-demand only](https://fireworks.ai/models/fireworks/qwen3p8-flash-next-fp8), requiring a dedicated deployment. I verified the existing OpenRouter configuration tests pass, but there’s no API key available here for a live latency comparison.
